tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia with slightly decreased hemoglobin and hematocrit, but normal red cell indices (MCV, MCH, MCHC) and erythrocyte count at the lower limit of normal, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is elevated, which may indicate increased platelet size variability, possibly due to platelet activation or turnover. No leukocyte abnormalities detected. Correlation with clinical context and further evaluation for anemia etiology is recommended.
